desc:
Welcome to White House Roleplay!

Explore Washington, D.C., become the President, join the Secret Service, work in law enforcement, or enjoy life as a civilian. The choice is yours!

Join departments, meet new people, and take part in events across the city.

We're always working on new features and improvements based on feedback from our community.

👍If you're enjoying the game, leave a like and favorite to support us!

🔔Join our community for updates, announcements, and more.
